summary: Provision temporary badge and encrypted loaner laptop pending pre-start background hold for incoming researcher
description:
Issue summary: New hire (Dr. Lina Alvarez, Research Scientist) has an official start date of 2026-03-22 but her background check vendor flagged a minor delay. HR requests a short-lived badge and fully encrypted loaner laptop to allow pre-start knowledge transfer calls and home-based setup without granting persistent domain credentials or long-lived service accounts.

Impact: Without a loaner laptop and temporary badge, the hiring manager cannot perform 2 days of scheduled shadowing sessions and secure onboarding calls. Team onboarding timelines at risk; low risk to production systems if access is scoped correctly.

Environment: Internal corporate prod systems for onboarding (SAML IdP, KMS-backed disk encryption, asset inventory). Region: us-west.

Request: 1) Issue a timebound guest building badge (valid 2026-03-15 to 2026-03-24) with floor-level access only; 2) Prepare an encrypted loaner laptop with full-disk encryption (company image) and no domain join; 3) Create a temporary, short-lived inventory-only service account (no repo or cloud access) for laptop enrollment; 4) Document the conditional access policy that will be revoked immediately on failed background or on official start cancellation.
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - operational request. Steps for fulfilment: 1) Confirm asset availability and reserve loaner unit; 2) Provision disk image with corporate MDM and FDE using KMS wrap key policy 'loaner-prestart'; 3) Create guest badge with expiry; 4) Create short-lived service account with expiration and audit logging; 5) Notify manager and HR with pickup window.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 - Owen Park (IT ops): Checked loaner inventory - a 13" encrypted MacBook (asset TAG LB-3309) is available at SF office. Needs re-image to company loaner profile.
2026-03-10 - Security (J. Patel): Loaner must use 'loaner-prestart' KMS key and have remote wipe enabled. No offline token storage. Confirmed policy change required to allow non-domain enrollment.

2026-03-11 - HR (M. Singh): Background check vendor ETA 2026-03-18. Manager requests access starting 2026-03-15 for remote shadowing. Prefer pickup at SF office or courier to candidate's address (requires approval).
2026-03-11 - SRE (A. Gomez): Verified that temporary service account template exists (template name: sa-temporary-onboard). Need to ensure expiration set to 2026-03-24 and no API keys are issued.
Hypothesis: If we provide a non-domain-joined, KMS-encrypted loaner with only local account + MDM, we can enable pre-start work while maintaining separation from production resources.
Risks identified: courier shipping increases risk of device loss; local pickup reduces risk but requires badge activation. Temporary badge must be scope-limited and logged.
Action items: Reserve LB-3309, draft badge policy entry for 2026-03-15 to 03-24, prepare MDM profile 'loaner-prestart', create service account with TTL and audit hooks, schedule pickup window.

resolution_notes: Pending - work in progress. Current plan: image loaner with 'loaner-prestart' FDE profile on 2026-03-14, create guest badge with expiry 2026-03-24, and hand off at concierge 2026-03-15 15:00. Follow-ups: 1) On official start (2026-03-22) revoke loaner local account and enroll candidate into domain if background clears; 2) If background check fails, remotely wipe device and reclaim asset; 3) Document the exception in Confluence with rationale and audit log links.
